decisions.reason: The net price display plugin is close to the core shop offer and cheap to maintain, but its absence from the website in 2020 to 2021 signals weaker attention, so the risk of withdrawal is moderate rather than a clear shortfall that calls for dropping it.
The ERP interface supports the firm's end-to-end and multichannel direction and client retention, so it likely still meets aspirations despite lower visibility on the website.

As the surviving price comparison plugin after C and E were consolidated away, it probably carries that function, though its absence from the website and possible platform changes raise the risk of withdrawal.
The net price reporting plugin is a low-cost niche add-on for B2B shops that growth and hiring slack can carry, but it is not visible on the website and could be folded into Product A.
